title: About me
text:
I am Aran Felix, a statistician and data analyst. I take a question that matters to you, find or build the evidence to answer it, and explain the answer so you can act on it.
I hold a BSc in Statistics and currently work as a data analyst with ADAC Consultancy. I combine questionnaire design, digital data collection, statistical analysis, qualitative research and dashboarding, so one person can carry a project from research design to a finished report.

title: About me
text:
What I am looking for

Roles: Data Analyst, Research Analyst or Officer, Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst, and Business Intelligence or Reporting Analyst.
Sectors: banks and financial institutions, NGOs and development organisations, research institutions, and data-driven businesses.
Also: freelance and consulting projects.

title: About me
text:
How I can help




Research and questionnaire design


Turn a vague question into a study you can answer: objectives, sampling, questionnaires and a data collection plan.





Digital data collection


Collect data on phones and tablets with ODK Collect, KoboToolbox, REDCap and CAPI, with quality checks along the way.





Quantitative analysis


Clean, test and model survey and programme data in SPSS, Stata, R or Python, and interpret the results.





Qualitative analysis


Code interviews and focus groups in NVivo or ATLAS.ti and draw out themes that trace back to what people said.





Monitoring and evaluation


Set up indicators, check data quality, track progress and report evidence to donors and boards.





Dashboards and reporting


Build Tableau and Power BI dashboards, SQL and Excel reports, and clear charts that show decision-makers what is happening.

title: About me
text:

Banks and financial institutions that need accurate, well-documented reporting and analysis.
NGOs and development programmes that need credible M&E evidence for donors and boards.

title: About me
text:
Why work with me

I work from questionnaire to report. I design the instrument, collect the data digitally, analyse it and report it, so quality is protected at every step.
I work on both sides of research. Numbers show the scale of a problem and interviews explain it. I can do both, which matters in research and M&E.
I show my working. Methods are documented and analyses are reproducible, and my code is open on GitHub.
I tell you what the data cannot say. You get limitations and uncertainty stated plainly, not a result that sounds more certain than it is.

I walk you through the findings so you can explain and defend them.



Where work was done for clients, I share only what I am permitted to disclose and anonymise the rest.

title: Kenya Registered Voters and Polling Stations, 2017 and 2022
text:
The question
How did voter registration and the network of polling stations change between the 2017 and 2022 Kenyan general elections, and what does that mean for how the electoral system serves voters?

title: Kenya Registered Voters and Polling Stations, 2017 and 2022
text:
Why it matters
Voter registers and polling-station networks shape who can take part in an election and how elections are planned and observed. Comparing two election cycles shows where the system grew, where it stayed flat, and where the load on each station increased.

title: Kenya Registered Voters and Polling Stations, 2017 and 2022
text:
Planned analysis

Combine and clean the registration and polling-station data for both elections so the two years can be compared fairly.
Check that area names and boundaries match across years, and document anything that does not.
Measure change in registered voters and polling stations, and the number of voters per station.
Show the results with interactive charts and tables, and state the limitations of the data.

title: Research & M&E
text:
How I handle evidence

Honest limits. Every analysis states what the data can and cannot show, including missing data and sampling issues.
Association is not cause. I say clearly when a result describes a pattern rather than an effect.
Confidentiality. I follow the ethics and data-protection requirements of each project and anonymise anything shared publicly.
